subject: imageRename only select stations under inDir

messages.author: 2c41ffaf8b8195e4
messages.subject: imageRename only select stations under inDir
parts:
Hello!

I have renamed all of my images that are organized as follows: inDir/station

However, I have since found some errors that I've corrected with timeshift in the original (unnamed data).  Now, I would like to rerun imageRename but only for a few of the stations (that had time fixes).  I don't want to run it on all of the photos under my inDir.  Is there a way to specify which stations are to be renamed so that it doesn't rename all photos in all stations?

Thank you for your assistance,
Patricia

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: imageRename only select stations under inDir
parts:
Hi Patricia, 
that functionality is currently not implemented. A quick and dirty solution would be to just move the few station directories into a separate folder, run imageRename, and then move them back. It's not ideal but should work.
Just running imageRename again on all images is not an option? Did you start tagging images already?`
Best regards,
Jürgen
